title: feat: serve every Chat text model on /v1/responses
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Every text model listed for /v1/chat/completions now also lists and serves /v1/responses. Models with a native Responses upstream use it directly; Claude, Gemini, Chat-registered community models, and chat-only agents such as Floret run through the existing Chat pipeline, with their answers converted to Responses JSON or SSE. The adapter handles instructions, messages, images, files, parallel function calls and outputs, tools, response formatting, reasoning effort, sampling, prompt caching, and user identifiers. Native and adapted candidates can fall back to each other with per-attempt rate limits. Requests that cannot be expressed in Chat, such as those using max_tool_calls, return 400 for an adapted primary and skip adapted fallbacks. Adapted requests use Chat's existing gateway context, credentials, usage checks, and billing path while charging once. Missing usage returns a 502 for JSON requests; SSE emits an error and response.failed without a charge. Model registry and documentation were updated to reflect the expanded endpoint support.
